title: Bass & Flinders Gin Masterclass
summary: A two-hour guided gin masterclass in Dromana. Explore botanicals, blend a recipe and take home a 500ml bottle of your own gin.
recurrenceNote: Choose a dated session on the operator calendar; no fixed weekly day confirmed
accessibilityNotes: The operator lists wheelchair parking, access and amenities; call 1–2 days ahead for assistance.
weatherDependency: Indoor masterclass, not weather-dependent; rooftop bar weather-dependent
nearbyAttractions: Crittenden Wines (adjacent suburb); Red Hill Brewery; Mornington Peninsula Chocolaterie
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with Dromana wineries: Crittenden; Tuerong; add Peninsula Hot Springs for a full wellness day
editorVerdict: The most hands-on spirits experience on the Peninsula, and a bottle to take home.
editorNote:
The operator describes a two-hour guided class covering gin history, distillation and botanicals before you blend your own recipe. Its published inclusions are a cheese platter and a 500ml bottle of your gin to take home.

Choose a specific session on the operator calendar before planning the drive. Adults only; arrange a designated driver if you will be tasting spirits. Pair a confirmed class with a Dromana lunch or another nearby stop, allowing time for travel.
verificationNote: Experience, duration and location checked against the operator masterclass and Visit Us pages on 3 October 2026. Specific future sessions require the operator calendar.
